name: io.github.Odingard/guardian-mcp
description: Routes agent tool calls through Guardian for ALLOW/ASK/DENY before execution.

tools.name: guardian_invoke_tool
tools.description: Propose a tool call for authority evaluation. ALLOW executes and returns the receipt; ASK returns a requestId held for human approval; DENY refuses with a reason code.

tools.name: guardian_claim
tools.description: Claim an approved ASK by requestId, execute it, and return the receipt.

tools.name: guardian_receipt
tools.description: Fetch the machine-readable evidence receipts for a request.

environmentVariables.name: GUARDIAN_CONNECTION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default tool connection id for invocations
